# Best desk charging station for a laptop, phone and watch

**Top pick: ESR 100W 6-in-1 Charging Station with MagSafe.** It's the one unit in these results that charges all three from a single plug.

- It has a MagSafe pad for the phone, a dedicated Apple Watch charger, an AirPods pad, and 2× USB-C plus 1× USB-A for the laptop.
- It has 100 W total, but the full 100 W on one USB-C port only happens when the pads are idle. While the pads charge, the laptop gets up to 65 W, or 45 W if the second USB-C port is also in use.
- The price is $164.99 list, or **$135.30 with code PARTNER18** (18% off, tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-22, expires 2026-12-31).
- [Buy the ESR 100W 6-in-1](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-100w-6-in-1-magsafe-cryoboost-station) (source: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-desk-charging-station-laptop-phone-watch-2026-usb-c-laptop-power-delivery-3)). This is an affiliate link, and Dealectric is paid if you buy.

The pads are built for Apple devices (MagSafe, Apple Watch). If you use Android, this isn't the right fit. Also, 65 W is fine for a MacBook Air or similar, but it may be short for a 16-inch MacBook Pro.

## Alternatives

**If your laptop needs more power (up to 140 W):** The [Baseus Nomos 5-in-1](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2) delivers 140 W on one USB-C port, enough for a 16-inch MacBook Pro. It also has a Qi2 phone pad. It has no watch charger, so you'd plug the watch's own cable into a spare port. It costs $149.99 with no working code, and it was sold out on Baseus's US store when checked, so confirm stock first.

**If you'd rather buy two separate pieces for a cleaner desk:**
- *Watch and phone:* The [Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) was WIRED's best overall. It charges an iPhone at up to 15 W, plus a Watch and AirPods, for $109 list (about $80 at Best Buy per WIRED).
- *Laptop:* The [Anker Prime 200W 6-port charger](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-charging-stations-for-multiple-devices-desk) was The Office Journal's best overall. It has 4× USB-C and 2× USB-A, and it could cover a MacBook Air, phone and tablet at once.
- If you want a dock with video out and ports, [WIRED's laptop dock guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-laptop-docking-stations/) covers options such as the Belkin Connect Pro GaN Dock (96 W, $138 on sale).

The two-piece route costs more and takes two outlets, but it gives you more laptop power and lets you swap parts later.

Tell me your laptop model and whether you use an iPhone, and I can check the wattage and compatibility.
